examples.label: Monthly revenue KPI with an upward trend and a report link
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="stat-monthly-revenue" size="large" title="Monthly revenue" value="$48,320" description="12.4% more than February" trend="up">
  <:figure>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-banknotes" class="size-9" />
  </:figure>
  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" href="/admin/reports/revenue" size="extra_small" variant="outline" color="primary">View full report</.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>

examples.label: Service uptime card for a status page
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="stat-service-uptime" variant="bordered" color="success" title="Uptime, last 90 days" value="99.98%" description="No incidents since 4 January" trend="neutral" figure_position="top">
  <:figure>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-shield-check" class="size-7" />
  </:figure>
  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" href="/status/history" size="extra_small" variant="outline" color="success">Incident history</.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>

examples.label: Storage usage with an upgrade prompt
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="stat-storage-usage" variant="shadow" color="warning" title="Storage used" value="84 GB of 100 GB" description="At this rate you run out in about 11 days">
  <:figure>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-circle-stack" class="size-7" />
  </:figure>
  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" href="/billing/plans" size="extra_small" variant="default" color="warning">Upgrade plan</.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>
